description: AbstractProxyIntegrationTest.java defines an abstract test class for proxy integration testing in the mockserver project, including setup, request forwarding tests, and verification methods.

classes.name: AbstractProxyIntegrationTest
classes.description: Abstract class providing setup, utility methods, and tests for proxy integration testing in mockserver.
